conflicts: Nd nuclear magnetic-moment ratio mu(143)/mu(145): 1.60861(2) from the mean A-ratio of the 4f4 6s2 5I levels (Childs & Goodman 1972) and 1.60883(4) from ENDOR (Halford 1962), versus 1.626(12) from atomic-beam resonance (Smith & Unsworth 1965); all as quoted in Persson arXiv:0904.0516 Table 2. Spalding 1963 gives 1.60860(36).
Nd isotopic abundances: NIST composition table gives 142Nd 27.152(40) % and 143Nd 12.174(26) %; the IAEA/ENSDF table gives 27.153(40) % and 12.173(26) % (last-digit difference only).
not_found: radiative lifetimes of Nd I levels: Den Hartog, Fittante, Lawler, J. Phys. B 44, 225001 (2011) (100 levels, +/-5%) and Biemont et al., J. Phys. B (2004) (15 odd levels) are paywalled; only the abstracts (no numbers) could be opened, so no lifetime is given for any drawn level (20176.912, 20300.875, 21184.881, 21345.572, 21543.326, 21572.610, 23996.513, 25518.7 cm^-1)
transition probabilities / branching fractions: Stockett, Wood, Den Hartog, Lawler, J. Phys. B 44, 235003 (2011) (236 lines) is paywalled; the NIST ASD A-values already on the site come from it

hyperfine constants of the 4f4 6s2 5I5-5I8 levels and of 5I4 for 145Nd (Childs & Goodman, Phys. Rev. A 6, 1772 (1972)): paywalled; a web-search snippet gave A(145Nd, 5I4) = -121.627(27) Mc/s (Spalding 1963) but the page showing it could not be opened, so it is not entered
hyperfine constants of the odd-parity levels the site draws (4f4 6s6p 5K*, 5H*): none located
isotope shifts of Nd I lines (neutral atom): only Nd II (ion) isotope-shift work was found openly; none entered
precise (laser/frequency-comb) transition frequencies for Nd I: none located

laser-cooling lines: Nd has not been laser-cooled (Hovhannesyan & Lepers, arXiv:2209.15479, state it 'has not yet been considered for laser-cooling'); that paper is a level-energy modelling study and proposes no specific cooling line, so no 'use' annotation is given
notes: Thin file: the key Nd I measurements (lifetimes, branching fractions, ground-term hyperfine structure) are in paywalled journals that could not be opened in this session. Hyperfine A constants are for the even-parity metastable levels 7L5, 7L11, 7K4 (second-hand) and the ground level 5I4 of 143Nd (abstract of the original paper). Nuclear spins 7/2 for 143Nd and 145Nd from the IAEA/ENSDF ground-state table (https://nds.iaea.org/relnsd/v1/data?fields=ground_states&nuclides=143nd).
